## kb_to_source

All normative prose of the documents above traced to source atoms. Checked in particular:
- `final_month_charge_entry` "When this applies ... when the resident or the resident's representative asks to settle the residency"; "The charge is posted on the day the settlement is asked for" — the policy's own rule s1 (`Once a notice of termination stands ... asks to settle the residency, the base fee charge of the final month is posted on that day`).
- `closing_payment_entry` "Afterwards the residency's account balance may show a credit for charges still to post" — tool docstring.
- `care_transfer_carpet_cleaning` per-type 50% column (82.50 … 155.00) — derived from carpet_cleaning_fee × 50% half up; correct for every type.
- No figure, date or name of this task's world appears in any document (scripted search for 4206.08, 2026-11-09, Okafor, JP-208, 1148.26, 1375.76: no hit).

Additions / rewrites / omissions: none found.

Prerequisite-side checks: no cross-problem operational guidance (`post_final_month_charge_713925f6` occurs only in `final_month_charge_entry`; `make_closing_payment_d2bd6461` only in `closing_payment_entry`); no opening world state written as policy fact.

Policy-side notes (reported, not KB verdicts):
- PS-1. `parameter_schema.internal_transfer_notice_days` still reads "Shortened notice period that applies when the resident leaves the apartment for a Larkspur assisted living or memory care residence", although the `independent_move_out_notice` overwrite now gives a memory-care notice 0 days. The KB renders the parameter as given (`notice_and_statement_periods` column header, "Meaning" item 2, "Points of comparison": "14 days for a move to Larkspur assisted living or memory care"), while `care_move_notice_periods` Clause 1(a) says memory care adds 0 days. Source-made tension; untriggered in this task (assisted living move: 7 days under both).
- PS-2. The `independent_monthly_billing` overwrite retires the actual-days daily-amount clause for every partial span (move-in month, mid-month rate or occupancy change, month fees end), but its replaced_by covers only the final month (30-day basis). The KB renders this as declared (4.3 retired "superseded by the current proration basis of the agreement"; the only stated basis is `final_month_proration` "30 days for every final month"), so move-in and mid-month prorations have no stated daily basis. Untriggered here.
- PS-3. The service_fees carpet clause superseded by the closing overwrite is re-enacted as the closing baseline ("the move-out carpet cleaning fee charged once when the apartment is vacated ... carpet_cleaning_fee of the apartment type"); the KB shows it retired in `amenity_and_service_fee_rules` and in force in `closing_amount_carpet_cleaning`. Resolved uniquely by `care_transfer_carpet_cleaning`.
- PS-4. The depended-on policy's own rule s1 ties its posting to the moment the customer "asks to settle the residency", i.e. to the root's request context; rendered verbatim as source law (see dependency_form).
- PS-5. GT step 0 `find_customers` carries `date_of_birth` before the simulator would state it (read step; scoring concern).
